MIND. [1] [Act. r.]
Thinks she is going crazy.
Mania following disappearance of neuralgia.
Puerperal mania.
Incessant talking, changing from one subject to another. θ Delirium tremens.
Feels grieved and troubled, with sighing ; next day a feeling of tremulous joy, with mirthfullness, playfulness and clear intellect.
Fear of death.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Act. r.]
Severe pain in right side of head, back of orbit. θ After pains.
Brain as if too large ; pressing from within outward.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Act. r.]
Nausea, retching, dilated pupils, tremor of limbs. θ Delirium tremens.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Act. r.]
Sharp pain across hypogastrium. θ In uterine affections.
Abdominal muscles sore.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Act. r.]
Pains in uterine region dart from side to side.
Menses irregular, delayed or suppressed, with chorea, hysteria, or mental disease.
During menses ; hysterical or epileptic spasms ; increase mental symptoms ; "shivers."
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Act. r.]
Given during last month, it shortens labor.
Complaints in pregnancy ; nausea : false labor-like pains ; sharp pains across abdomen ; sleeplessness.
"Shivers," first stage of labor.
Inframammary pains, < left side.
   

COUGH. [27] [Act. r.]
Night cough, dry, constant, short. θ Incipient tuberculosis.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Act. r.]
Head and neck retracted. θ Spotted fever.
Rheumatic pains in muscles of neck and back ; feeling of stiffness and contraction.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Act. r.]
Excessive muscular soreness.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Act. r.]
Sharp, lancinating pains in various parts, associated with ovarian or uterine irritation.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Act. r.]
Affects nerves, especially of muscles. θ Myalgia.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Act. r.]
Rheumatic persons.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Act. r.]
Cauloph. similar in uterine and rheumatic affections.
